lastCompletedStory.title: Route worker-report readers in host.ts and loop.ts through parseWorkerReport

nextStoryContext: host.ts's makeReadWorkerReport now delegates directly to parseWorkerReport(raw) (raw file text in, typed WorkerReport|null out); loop.ts's poll-exit worker-report check round-trips the already-typed readWorkerReport() return value through parseWorkerReport(JSON.stringify(rawReport)) before applying the advisoryStoryId staleness comparison, since that call site's dep is statically typed WorkerReport but is not runtime-guaranteed to match (tests construct wrong-shape objects via `as WorkerReport`). result.ts's readWorkerOutcome (string-source consumer of report-parse.ts, per report-parse.ts's own module doc comment) still uses its own ad-hoc guards and was NOT touched by this story -- if the PRD calls for wiring result.ts onto parseWorkerReport/parseReviewReport next, that is a follow-up, not implied by US-002's acceptance criteria (which named only host.ts + loop.ts). One pre-existing test (test/supervisor/loop.test.ts's 'AC4: host.ts makeReadWorkerReport applies shape guard...' test) pinned the OLD inline-guard source text and was updated to assert 'parseWorkerReport' presence instead -- if a future story further changes host.ts's reader internals, that test will need another look.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal refactor wiring two already-existing hand-rolled TS modules (host.ts, loop.ts) onto the shared report-parse.ts parser from US-001; no external library surface touched.
